gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 identifies an ill-posed all-measures/all-measurable-functions example because some constructed laws fall outside the P2 framework. It does not identify the separate empirical-covariance root-N rate claim, its missing fourth-moment hypothesis, or the heavy-tailed finite-variance counterexample showing that the rate fails.

Both entries identify the ETKF transform normalization error: omitting the factor 1/(N-1) makes the transformed covariance subtract (N-1) times the required Kalman decrement and can make the purported square-root matrix non-positive-semidefinite. ISSUE-004 supplies the corresponding corrected transform formula.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The ETKF transform equation is inconsistent with the 1/(N-1) sample-covariance convention, so it fails to produce the advertised analysis covariance and may not admit the claimed principal square root.

component_coverage.gold_component: The ETKF transform uses an incorrectly normalized right-hand side, causing the transformed anomalies to have the wrong analysis covariance and potentially making the square-root argument indefinite.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 explicitly derives the missing 1/(N-1) factor, states the resulting overlarge covariance decrement and possible loss of positive semidefiniteness, and identifies the failure of the advertised ETKF second-moment condition.

component_coverage.gold_component: The formula should be repaired by inserting the factor 1/(N-1) in the transform and principal-square-root expression.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 gives the specific corrected transform normalization and says it must be propagated through the square-root formula and subsequent substitution.
